tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search event series by name, country or vertical. Each row carries edition count, last and next start dates and the largest captured exhibitor count.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: One event series by slug or uuid with organizer, venue, tags and every edition (ids, dates, exhibitor / sponsor / speaker / country counts). Use an edition id with list_edition_exhibitors.

tools.name: upcoming_events
tools.description: Trade-show and exhibition editions starting in a date window, soonest first, optionally filtered by country, vertical or venue.
